raw_result.task_text: I have a video call starting in 5 minutes. My desk area needs to look presentable and I should be able to see and hear clearly. The bedroom light is off.

central_instructions.R1: Prepare any light objects in the living room that need to be passed to R2 for the bedroom.
central_instructions.R2: Move to the bedroom to assist R3 and R4 by passing any necessary light objects and ensuring the desk area is tidy.
central_instructions.R3: Ensure the desk area in the bedroom is organized and presentable for the video call.
central_instructions.R4: Turn on the bedroom light and adjust any heavy objects or furniture to ensure the area is clear and presentable.

agent_plans.R1:
[0-5 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Identify any light objects in the living room that need to be passed to R2 for the bedroom. (r1_s1)
- R1 [LOCAL] Pick up the identified light object(s) (e.g., small lamp or decor item). (r1_s2)

[5-10 min]
- R2 [HELP] Enter the living room to receive objects from R1. (r2_s1)
- R1 [PASS] Hand the light object(s) to R2. (r1_s3)
- R2 [RECEIVE] Take the light object(s) from R1 to the bedroom. (r2_s2)
agent_plans.R2:
[0-5 min]
- R2 [LOCAL] Move to the bedroom to assist R3 and R4. (r2_s1)
- R3 [LOCAL] Organize desk area, ensuring items are neatly arranged. (r3_s1)
- R4 [LOCAL] Turn on the bedroom light for better visibility. (r4_s1)

[5-10 min]
- R2 [PASS] Hand light objects to R3 to help tidy the desk area. (r2_s2)
- R3 [RECEIVE] Take light objects from R2 and place them appropriately on the desk. (r3_s2)
- R4 [HELP] Assist R3 by adjusting the position of the desk lamp for optimal lighting. (r4_s2)
agent_plans.R3:
[0-5 min]
- R3 [LOCAL] Turn on the desk lamp to improve lighting for the video call. (r3_s1)
- R3 [LOCAL] Arrange the items on the desk neatly, ensuring the notebook, pen, and phone are aligned and tidy. (r3_s2)

[5-10 min]
- R3 [LOCAL] Ensure the laptop is open and positioned correctly for the video call. (r3_s3)
- R3 [LOCAL] Check that the chair is positioned properly in front of the desk for comfortable seating. (r3_s4)
agent_plans.R4:
[0-5 min]
- R4 [LOCAL] Turn on the bedroom light. (r4_s1)
- R4 [LOCAL] Push the chair under the desk to clear the area. (r4_s2)
- R4 [LOCAL] Adjust the desk lamp to ensure proper lighting for the video call. (r4_s3)

[5-10 min]
- R4 [LOCAL] Move any heavy objects on the desk to the side to make the area look tidy. (r4_s4)
- R4 [LOCAL] Ensure the pathway to the desk is clear by pushing any obstructive furniture aside. (r4_s5)
